CHAMPION-RESEED.description: Retain champion semantics, rebuild a fresh residual population and reset continuation state.

PERSIST.description: Restore the complete fitted learner state.

POPULATION-RESEED.description: Retain the complete population tree-semantics multiset and champion designation, but assign canonical fresh identities and reset all continuation metadata.

composer_preflight_obligations: Champion tree hash is identical before and after POPULATION-RESEED.
Population tree-hash multiset is identical before and after POPULATION-RESEED.
All inherited identifiers, ordinals, parent links, counters and event serials are absent from the reset state.
Canonical fresh ordering is deterministic and duplicate-safe.
Provenance is referentially closed and future-blind.
Construction work is charged and arm allowances remain prospectively matched.
No DEV qualification uses EXT feature or label values.
Differential and metamorphic tests pass before the first EXT source value is generated.

contingency.if_campaign_is_infrastructure_invalid: repair by versioned outcome-blind procedure; never score as learner failure
contingency.if_scientific_result_is_inconclusive: report inconclusive; do not expand sample size or modify estimands post outcome

derived_identity: J_SUM = J1 + J2 = E[L(CHAMPION-RESEED)-L(PERSIST)] under a common target and outcome definition.

failure_policy.algorithm_failure_after_valid_start: retain full planned denominator; remaining prediction slots receive 0-1 loss 1
failure_policy.source_or_integrity_failure: INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID; no scientific record; versioned repair before rerun
failure_policy.treatment_unavailable: retain full denominator; no fallback treatment

forbidden_interpretations: J1 is not a universal value of diversity.
J2 is not a universal value of history or genealogy.
Neither estimand identifies order-independent Shapley values.
The study does not expand external validity beyond the specified scenario system.
No monetary cost-effectiveness claim is authorised.
prespecified_secondary: J_SUM algebraic closure and non-pooled replication of Study 1 H2
LOCAL_TREE versus OBLIQUE family interaction for J1 and J2
checkpoint 20000 minus checkpoint 10000 effect modification for J1 and J2
500-observation embedded horizon for J1 and J2
separate APW, CPU, elapsed, RSS, prediction latency, state size and provenance size summaries

primary_estimands.J1: E[L(CHAMPION-RESEED)-L(POPULATION-RESEED)] over the equal-scenario design mixture; positive favours residual-population retention.
primary_estimands.J2: E[L(POPULATION-RESEED)-L(PERSIST)] over the equal-scenario design mixture; positive favours continuation-state retention.

primary_inference.method: paired equal-scenario stratified symmetric absolute bootstrap-t over whole independent streams
primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm over the fixed two-estimand family
primary_inference.resampling_unit: whole stream within scenario; both checkpoints and all three arms travel together
primary_inference.simultaneous_intervals: Bonferroni marginal confidence level 0.975 with absolute bootstrap-t critical values

primary_outcome: mean prequential 0-1 loss over the next 2000 observations

publication_derivative.transformation: Only local environment path values in authoritative_inputs were replaced by source-object basenames; all scientific fields and SHA-256 bindings were preserved.

randomness.key_rule: first 64 bits (16 lowercase hex) of SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 address

sample_size.gate: minimum grid value with worst joint classification >=0.90 and maximum p95 primary half-width <=0.0015
sample_size.historical_planning_source: Study 1 H2 within-scenario residual distribution; planning proxy only, not a power guarantee

state_atoms.C: incumbent champion tree semantics and champion designation
state_atoms.G: referentially closed provenance certificate required for transferred semantics but not treated as an independent predictive atom
state_atoms.O: continuation metadata including optimiser key/context, ordinals, identities, parent links, counters and event serials
state_atoms.R: multiset of residual population tree semantics, excluding inherited continuation metadata
